title: Example DCAT-US 3.0 Catalog Where A Series Member Is Also Top-Level
description: A sample DCAT-US 3.0 catalog where a dataset is listed both at the top level and as a DatasetSeries seriesMember, used for harvest testing.

dataset.title: Annual Report 2023
dataset.description: The first dataset in the series, also listed at the catalog's top level.

datasetSeries.title: Annual Report Series
datasetSeries.description: A series of annual reports, one dataset per year.

seriesMember.title: Annual Report 2023
seriesMember.description: The first dataset in the series, also listed at the catalog's top level.

seriesMember.title: Annual Report 2024
seriesMember.description: The second dataset in the series, not listed at the top level.
